scene: The hatch reveals hidden transit docks below the arcade.
picture: Along a wide stone transit platform, the woman in lilac headscarf, mustard coat, and satchel stands left of centre. A red mountain cable tram waits open at far left. A flat wooden river barge bobs on canal water at centre. An ornate brass spiral lift sits open at far right.
shown: a red mountain cable tram docked with open doors at far left
a wooden river barge floating beside the low platform at centre
an ornate brass spiral lift cage with open gate at far right

variants.scene: Cool canal water laps against the stone platforms beneath the bustling arcade arches.
Warm lantern light glows over quiet underground waterways as you ponder {quest}.
Sleek tracks and gentle ripples invite you to continue through the subterranean station.
